correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the adjacency graph from all nonzero quadratic residues mod37, all increasing cliques and f=(37,333,888,555). Independently performed 297 nonabelian triangle unit relator eliminations after a BFS maximal tree, proving simply connectedness, not just H1=0. The 555 tetrahedra and 888 triangles yield 666 exactly-two-coface rows, whose signed incidence graph has three consistent 185-vertex components and primitive rank552. The other 222 rows reduce to six signed 3-vectors, each appearing 37 times; independently computed determinantal divisors 1,1,26. Thus full ∂3 has 554 unit factors and one 26, yielding H2=Z^36⊕Z/26, H3=0. The simply connected finite three-dimensional CW reduction and integral matrix normal form permit classification as wedge of S2 and a degree26 Moore space; Whitehead theorem supplies the homotopy upgrade. Graph diameter two checked from quadratic residues. All calculations are finite exhaustive for this exact 37-vertex graph, not a uniform Paley conjecture.
